rules.condition: writing GPIO outputs in direct-write mode
rules.statement: Each of the 32 independent GPIO bits can be written as a peripheral output via direct write, giving software simultaneous control of all 32 bits.

rules.condition: writing GPIO outputs in masked-write mode
rules.statement: Masked write modifies only the selected bits of a 16-bit half, using the user-provided mask and new values, without read-modify-write; unmasked bits keep their output value.
Software can read each of the 32 GPIO bits as peripheral inputs.

rules.condition: interrupt configured for a GPIO bit
rules.statement: Software can configure interrupt event detection for any of the 32 bits as positive edge, negative edge or level detection.

rules.condition: noise filter enabled for a GPIO input
rules.statement: The input must be stable for 16 module clock cycles before the input register reflects the change and interrupt generation is evaluated.

rules.condition: filter enabled and pin set to output
rules.statement: A change in output value is reflected in the input register with a corresponding filter delay.
